freeze_status: Historical analysis plan declared before its own computation; not external preregistration and not blind access to the original corpus. Earlier corpus marginals and related replay analyses had already been inspected.
scope: Final bounded offline implementation/calibration audit of constructed no-change pseudo-version contrasts. No real harness edits, model calls, API calls, network retrieval, upstream-code execution, new selector optimization or genuine release error guarantee.
unused_evaluation_attempt_indices: 5 through cohort N; no pair search or ordering sensitivity analysis
attempt_order_warning: Indices are each task's nth retained file-order occurrence, not synchronized rounds or timestamps.
subset_size_rule: max(1, round(n/10)), exact rational nearest-integer rounding with ties to even
history_allocation: Ordered binary attempts-1-and-2 pattern; proportional allocation with exact integer floor and largest remainder; remainder ties by pattern; smallest hashes within each stratum
slice_rule: int(SHA256(slice_hash_salt + ':' + task ID),16) modulo 4; same slices across views; membership uses IDs only, not candidate outcomes
rng: Python standard library random.Random, getrandbits(1) for each sorted (cohort, task ID) per replicate
orientation_rule: For each task and replicate, independently draw a fair bit. Bit 0 puts attempt 3 in pseudo-old and 4 in pseudo-new; bit 1 swaps them. Reuse that exact task orientation in every overlapping test. Even concordant tasks consume one bit.
conditioning: All retained task memberships, selection history, fixed evaluation outcomes and metadata are conditioned on. The constructed null is independent fair orientation of each task pair, not an asserted real-model or release null.
drop: (pseudo-old successes minus pseudo-new successes) / task count; positive means a drop

rules.five_pp_drop: greater than or equal to 1/20 (5 percentage points); illustrative sensitivity threshold, not a scientifically justified harm margin or statistical zero-effect test
rules.unadjusted_exact: one-sided paired-binomial/McNemar p <= 1/20; m discordances, L losses, p=sum(comb(m,k),k=L..m)/2**m; m=0 gives p=1
rules.holm: exact rational Holm step-down adjusted p values, reject adjusted p <= 1/20

per_test_null: Conditional fair-sign null for the fixed discordant task pairs (or one-sided no-excess-loss null under its necessary independent sign assumptions); not a test of a 5 pp harm margin

analysis_scopes.single_global: Each of 6 cohorts x 3 views, global test only; 18 global contrasts per replicate
analysis_scopes.within_family: Global plus all four prespecified hash slices for each cohort/view; 18 fixed five-test families, all planned hypotheses retained
analysis_scopes.audit_wide: All 6 x 3 x (1+4)=90 planned tests, with one Holm correction across the full fixed audit family

empty_and_no_discordance: Always retain test with p=1 and zero declarations. Empty-set drop is undefined (null in output), not zero evidence of safety. No-discordance or non-rejection is insufficient evidence, not equivalence or safety.
target_population: Every view targets its own fixed task set. Unweighted history-stratified subsets do not estimate a corrected whole-cohort causal effect. No weighted paired-binomial calculation.
outputs: Aggregate test definitions and analytical marginal probabilities, per-global and per-family pseudo-version declaration/alarm frequencies, audit-wide frequencies, conditional 95% Wilson Monte Carlo intervals, Monte Carlo-versus-exact marginal diagnostics and checker tests. Do not publish task IDs or raw source inputs.
monte_carlo_uncertainty: Intervals concern only repeated constructed fair-sign randomization conditional on this corpus. They are not scientific confidence intervals for real-agent failures, not simultaneous intervals, and not independent across overlapping tests or methods. No method-ranking test.
analytical_check: For each fixed test, enumerate the m+1 binomial loss counts with exact Fraction masses and exact thresholds to compute marginal declaration probabilities. Compare to 1000-replicate frequencies descriptively; do not reject or tune the protocol based on deviations.
checker_fixtures: Identical-pair negative control; deterministic all-loss positive fixture; boundary and finite-hypothesis Holm tests; empty/no-discordance tests. Fixtures are checker tests only, never empirical evidence of effectiveness.
source_limitations: Reported fixed setup, retained/filtered data, unknown sampling seeds and immutable model hash. Actual collection dependence and validity are not authenticated by this synthetic null.
decision_rule: Complete one auditable result. If this shows expected conditional noise/calibration only and no genuine real-edit data collection plan exists, recommend ARCHIVE the current regression branch rather than more toy prototypes. Do not claim adding standard statistics is novel.
cost: Zero model/API cost; no external calls. Local CPU work only.
